description: Revoke a signing key, for example after a device is lost. Signatures presented with it are refused from then on. Revoking another participant's key requires the admin role.

kid.description: Key id to revoke. It is marked revoked with a timestamp and a reason, and signatures presented with it are refused from then on. A key id that is unknown is refused with -32071.

reason.description: Why the key was revoked, e.g. 'laptop lost'. Recorded on the key and in the audit entry.

target_uri.description: Whose key is being revoked. Revoking another member's key requires the caller to hold the role 'admin'; otherwise the call is refused with -32011.

name: chap.participant.revoke_key
title: chap.participant.revoke_key
